package.name: cite_test_hardware
package.description:
`ros2_control` test doubles. Nothing in here describes real hardware, and nothing in here may be loaded by a production bring-up.
ADMISSION TEST, in the style of `cite_runtime` (ADR-0034), because a package named for what tests need will otherwise accumulate whatever a test needed. Something belongs here only if all four hold:
1. it is a `ros2_control` HARDWARE COMPONENT — a `SystemInterface`, `ActuatorInterface` or `SensorInterface` plugin, and nothing else; 2. it exists to make a FAILURE reproducible on demand, not to stand in for an arm that works; 3. it REFUSES TO INITIALISE unless it is given a parameter that has no home in the L0 facility model, so that no generated description can load it; 4. it is depended on by NOTHING that is not a test.
ADR-0040 records the decision, what was weighed against it, and which parts of "unreachable from a production launch path" are structural and which are checked by a guard test.
THE WHOLE PACKAGE IS BUILT ONLY UNDER `BUILD_TESTING`. A build with testing off installs an ament package containing no loadable class at all.
